notes.title: The Bunker, The Complex and more in the Ultimate FMV Bundle
notes.content:
Today we have a lot of news to share including the release of our latest interactive movie, The Complex!

Firstly, you will notice a small update to The Bunker which addresses some minor stability issues. Plus, The Bunker is [b]on sale with 50% off[/b] starting today at 6pm BST.

[b]The Interactive Movie Bundle[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13435

[b]The Ultimate FMV Bundle[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13434

[h2]The Complex [/h2]

From the publishing studio behind Late Shift, comes a new cinematic interactive sci-fi thriller movie for PC, Mac, PS4, Xbox One and Switch.

After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. With choose-your-own-path style gameplay, your actions and your relationship with other characters will lead you to one of eight suspenseful endings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36752512/503b73e604e8a4e37b36d1bb895242ca0dcb79bb.jpg[/img]

We want to thank everyone for their support in the build-up to the launch. With just hours of being released, we've had some incredible reviews which we'd like to share with you :)

[h3]9.5/10 – [url=https://www.godisageek.com/reviews/the-complex-review/]God is Geek[/url][/h3]
“Story is fantastically written, acting is brilliant and multiple endings massively help with replayability.”

[h3]9/10 – [url=http://www.digitallydownloaded.net/2020/03/review-complex-sony-playstation-4.html]Digitally Downloaded[/url][/h3]
“Phenomenal cast, complicated characters, a deep and rather dark narrative.”
 
[h3]8/10 – [url=https://www.godisageek.com/reviews/the-complex-review/]Gamespew[/url][/h3]
“A sharp, smartly written interactive thriller, with not a single one-dimensional character in sight, The Complex is (despite its theme) a joy to experience.” 

[h3]9/10 – [url=https://www.hookedgamers.com/pc/the_complex/review/article-2136.html]Hooked Gamers[/url][/h3]
“Wales Interactive has earned itself a reputation for being the bar to be measured by in the interactive movie genre, and I can’t wait to see where they go with it next.”

[h3]9/10 – [url=https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/39944]Adventure Gamers[/url][/h3]
“Once The Complex enters full-on thriller mode, this compelling choice-driven tale of a trapped scientist facing terrorists and moral decisions doesn’t let up and even provides enough prompting and interesting options to weather multiple plays.” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28053821/9f7f7819b1734c198ed7e9d262832467e8fb6215.jpg[/img]

That's it for now! Comment below or reach out to us with any of the links below. 

Wales Interactive

www.instagram.com/walesinteractive

notes.title: The Bunker price drop plus an extra 30% off!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vpUT5TU.gif[/img]

[h1]Price Drop![/h1]

You may have noticed that we have now permanently reduced the base price of The Bunker to align with our full collection of current and future FMV games on Steam! You can now purchase The Bunker for almost half the price of a cinema ticket — in UK unofficial currency, that’s the equivalent of 39 milk chocolate Freddos. 

To make those smiles bigger and to keep those wallets fatter, The Bunker has received an additional 30% off in the Wales Interactive Steam sale! 

Speaking of future FMV games, we were lucky enough to publish The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker on console which has led to a second title by D’Avekki Studios called The Shapeshifting Detective. We are yet to announce further details on this but expect to hear it VERY soon. 

[h1]Follow Our Steam Creator Page[/h1]
You can follow our news on [url=https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url] or our brand new [url= https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WalesInteractive]Steam Creator Homepage[/url] which you can [b]follow[/b] for updates on new game releases!

[h1]FMV Bundle[/h1]

We have bundled The Bunker with the hit FMV crime thriller Late Shift in the Wales Interactive FMV Bundle. Get it now with an additional 20% off on top of current sale for The Bunker. If you already own one game, you will still receive a discount on the other!

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6836/Late_Shift_and_The_Bunker__FMV_Bundle/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/481110/The_Bunker/

Head over to the forums to reminisce about your favourite FMV from the 90s! 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/584980/discussions/0/135511655652258962/

Wales Interactive

notes.title: Supporting New Languages & FMV Bundle!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nDsHFE7.gif[/img]

Wales Interactive are proud to bring you brand new language support for the award-winning FMV horror [b]The Bunker[/b]!

The Bunker now supports the following languages:

English
French
Italian
German
Spanish
Russian
Trad. Chinese
Simp. Chinese
Korean

[img]https://i.imgur.com/izpcakE.gif[/img]

[h1]FMV SALE[/h1]

We are reducing the price of The Bunker on Steam with a 50% discount which goes live today at 6pm BST / 10am PDT. 

[h1]FMV BUNDLE[/h1]

Not only that, we have bundled The Bunker with the hit FMV crime thriller Late Shift in the Wales Interactive FMV Bundle. Get it now with an additional 20% off. If you already own one game, you will still receive a discount on the other!

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6836/Late_Shift_and_The_Bunker__FMV_Bundle/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/481110/The_Bunker/

Head over to to the forums to reminisce about your favourite FMV from the 90s! 

We hope you enjoy the game and please do let us know your thoughts in the comments section! Thank you all for reading. 

Don’t forget you can follow Wales Interactive on our [url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url] page. 

Wales Interactive
